mapper.select: select distinct c.* from customer c join orders o on c.customer_id = o.customer_id
mapper.insert: insert into customer (customer_code, customer_name, name, address, postcode, phone, password) values (#{customerCode}, #{customerName}, #{name}, #{address}, #{postcode}, #{phone}, #{password})
mapper.update: update customer set customer_code = #{customerCode}, customer_name = #{customerName}, name = #{name}, address = #{address}, postcode = #{postcode}, phone = #{phone}, password = #{password} where customer_id = #{customerId}
